action_instruction: Reading Green Grocer delivery details from the order confirmation
intent: the scheduled delivery window and fee listed for Green Grocer in the order confirmation

action_params.condition: the confirmation lists "Green Grocer" as "Today 6pm–8pm · fee $3.99"
action_params.query: the scheduled delivery window and fee listed for Green Grocer in the order confirmation
action_params.code_js: (() => { const values = [...el(9).querySelectorAll('span')].map(s => s.textContent.trim()); const i = values.indexOf('Green Grocer'); return i < 0 ? null : values[i + 1] || null; })()
